input.user_goal: Explain what changed since the last visit.
input.evidence_packet_ref: Two encounter rows since last visit and one new document; granted_data_classes drives which delta sources are returned (e.g., medications, allergies, recent_events)

notes: AgentEvidenceToolset::fetchChangedSinceLastVisit takes granted_data_classes from the access token and only includes deltas in those classes. Caps {max_records=30, max_documents=5, lookback_days=365}.
